output.span: (ii) A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh. (5) In cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
output.reason: The evidence states that for a Tier 3 UCB, no pre-payment charges apply for floating rate business loans up to ₹50 lakh (“shall not levy any pre-payment charges… up to ₹50 lakh”). It also provides the residual rule that in cases other than those mentioned in paragraph 261(1) and (2), any pre-payment charges must follow the UCB’s approved policy (“shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB”). The evidence further indicates the sanctioned amount exceeds ₹50 lakh (₹8,000,000 > ₹5,000,000), placing the loan outside the no-charge threshold.
